item.title: JShell JEP 222: jshell: The Java Shell (Read-Eval-Print Loop)
item.author: emecas
item.description:
JEP 222: jshell: The Java Shell (Read-Eval-Print Loop)
https://openjdk.org/jeps/222
The JDK Enhancement Proposal behind jshell, Java’s read-eval-print loop: type declarations, statements and expressions and see each result at once. Delivered in JDK 9 (2017).

item.title: JDK 9 (schedule and features)
item.author: emecas
item.description:
JDK 9 (schedule and features)

http://openjdk.java.net/projects/jdk9/
The goal of this Project is to produce an open-source reference implementation of the Java SE 9 Platform, to be defined by a forthcoming JSR in the Java Community Process.

The schedule and features of this release are proposed and tracked via the JEP Process, as amended by the JEP 2.0 proposal.
